ordinary_proof: Normal half-Chebyshev elements square to zero at D4 centre; they kill simple modules. x semisimple with M weights; adjacent products are invertible constants, so every simple dimension is a positive multiple of M. Full D4 would require rank>=6M, but rank degree is2M.
consequence: Dminus is non-H3 at every even order. Together with prior results, all finite-order q!=+-1 cuts are H3 iff D!=Dplus,Dminus.
limits: Nonroot q admissibility and global H3 classification remain open.
